name: bytestash
description: ByteStash is a web-based application for managing and organising code snippets with a clean, modern interface. Features include syntax highlighting, categorisation, a full-fledged code editor.

paths.name: SNIPPET_DIRECTORY
paths.description: Directory where code snippets will be stored

variables.name: BASE_PATH
variables.description: Which base path should be used? E.g. /bytestash links to http:// :[PORT]/bytestash/. Always start with a forward slash. Leave empty if not required.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: Used for authentication, generate your own secure JWT secret and put it here

variables.name: TOKEN_EXPIRY
variables.description: How long the token lasts, examples: 24h, 7d, 2w

variables.name: OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME
variables.description: The OIDC provider name, e.g. Authelia, Authentik

variables.name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
variables.description: The auth URL of your SSO server, e.g. auth.website.com/application/o/bytestash

variables.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: The client secret you used to generate the hmac secret

variables.name: ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS
variables.description: Enable / disable the creation of new accounts
